crossRefs.note: There is one gone out of you, who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

translations.web: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
translations.bsb: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
translations.kjv: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
translations.asv: What do ye devise against Jehovah? he will make a full end; affliction shall not rise up the second time.
